title: Workshops — Vie Glow
description: Beginner micro-tattoo workshops with Van Ngo. Premade stencils, safety-focused, no experience needed.
hero_heading: Learn to tattoo, safely, from the ground up.
hero_text: No experience needed. Van walks beginners through the fundamentals using premade stencils, with the same safety and hygiene standards a professional studio holds itself to.
